captures.description: 'Grammata: Journal of Operative Philology is a conceptual, distributed academic journal operating at the intersection of literary theory, Marxist linguistics, and modern information architecture. It focuses on operative philology, a framework that treats language, archives, and digital systems (like AI constitutions) as active infrastructure rather than just passive historical records' (cites Academia.edu +3). Expanded under Core Themes & Methodology: 'The journal frequently publishes decentralized, open-access papers and digital preprints (often hosted via platforms like Zenodo and Academia.edu). Its primary focus areas include' (Google Scholar +1) — 'Platform Capitalism & Language: It explores how modern digital platforms and Large Language Models (LLMs) alienate human [truncated]'. Organic below: Zenodo 'RETRIEVAL FORMATION THEORY The Conditions of...' — 'Markers include: Named journals (Grammata: Journal of Operative Philology). ... Grammata: Journal of Operative Philology, 2026. ∮ = 1 + δ. The formation...' — and Academia.edu '(PDF) TLDR Operative Philology in the Wild v1.' The discipline name 'operative philology' surfaces as a recognized framework with an apparent house journal; the Retrieval Formation Theory citation includes the ∮ measurement operator, signaling that the Measurement of Meaning apparatus has folded into the same basin.
